Hello! I am so happy to see you are taking requests again! 

I would like to request an illustration of Iekushi Chapipi once more. She is a computer virus Vtuber. 

Chapipi will be celebrating her birthday soon and I would like to request a birthday themed art like you have done previously. Can you please draw her in a cute dress and use a cyberspace theme? I will leave pose and composition to you, so feel free to be creative. Please do not use Chapipis headphones.

Can Chapipi have permission to use this for SNS (twitter, youtube, schedule, etc)? If this is not ok, please decline.

Thank you for consideration!

Reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Jn2uQ90UAAXrGUgoZM16hDljSP73B35e?usp=drive_link
